notes.note: Compute-optimal scaling (Chinchilla) relates pretraining tokens to model parameters, not per-user streamed tokens. No scaling law requires each user's inference tokens to equal the pretraining corpus; inference-aware research only addresses aggregate demand across all users.
notes.claim: If the cost equalization heuristic holds, the total inference tokens generated by a model over its deployment should approximately equal the total pre-training tokens.
